changes.to: Maker product page and e-manual: 20 actuator modules (6 DOF leg x 2, 3 DOF arm x 2, 2 DOF neck), DYNAMIXEL MX-28 actuators with metallic gears (the academic-edition datasheet lists RX-28M), CM-730 sub-controller (ARM Cortex-M3 STM32F103RE), Intel Atom Z530 1.6 GHz PC with 4 GB flash, default walking speed 24.0 cm/s at 0.25 s per step, 3-axis gyro and accelerometer, two microphones, battery good for about 30 minutes with hot-swap support, 3 Mbps DYNAMIXEL bus. Height 454.5 mm and weight 2.9 kg are from the ROBOTIS DARwIn-OP academic-edition datasheet (SKU 905-0012-310); the maker page shows the same figures in an image table. Line is discontinued. No payload or IP rating is published.
Open Platform: source code (SourceForge), ROBOTIS e-manual, ROBOTIS Framework
DARwIn-OP, the open-platform miniature humanoid ROBOTIS built with the University of Pennsylvania, became the standard small-size robot for RoboCup research and education.
